# Pinned early-progression advancement fixtures

These four JSON files are copied unchanged from Tinkers' Construct
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`:

https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/tree/f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2/src/generated/resources/data/tconstruct/advancements/recipes/misc

`materials_and_you.json` is beneath `common/`, `book_substitute.json` beneath
`tables/`, and `sand_cast.json`/`red_sand_cast.json` beneath `smeltery/`.
`sha256.json` records the source bytes. Native adaptations change only recipe
IDs and the recipe-unlocked predicate field.
